generator_metadata.summary: Infer a 5x5 0/8 lattice, then expand anomalies into below-right zero masks.

review_brief:
# Review summary — a1ece4864521

The supplied base generator was not faithful to the full canonical grammar: it fixed one latent tile and excluded repeated-color, binary `0/8`, and higher-count anomaly cases present in the canonical records. I repaired the sampler and self-check so it now generates variable 5×5 latent lattices, 1–9 anomalies, repeated colors, binary corruptions, strict controls, and canonical-consistent labels.

I built a native two-setting family. `fill_route=below_right` preserves the exact selected canonical Racket bytes. `fill_route=phase_diagonal` first reconstructs the clean lattice and per-anomaly clean phase, then uses that input-dependent intermediate to choose an above-left or below-right zero-mask. The family supports 2–6 demonstrations, 1–4 queries, matched inputs across settings, a privately shuffled four-query bank, 10×10 and substantive 30×30 cases, a native adapter, promotion contract, source inventory, and a reusable protected-Racket adversarial probe.

Adversarial review found and repaired one concrete teaching hole: the initial two-example lesson let a “use the row-major first anomaly’s phase for every route” shortcut fit all demonstrations. The repaired lesson crosses first phases 0 and 8 and refutes ten declared task-relevant rivals. Final evidence covers 24 episodes, 82 unique protected-Racket executions, five validator attacks, crossed phase/dimension controls, 13 focused tests, native authoring preflight, a protected causal counterfactual, 16 one-query public views, 24 private-field invariance checks, and staged task tests.

This return is reviewer-ready authoring evidence only. The base was unapproved when assigned; owner source review, fresh native qualification, acceptance replay, and any training admission remain separate. Finite probes and the authored causal interpretation do not prove universal uniqueness or depth.

sequential_dependency.intermediate: An ordered per-anomaly record of (row, column, observed value, reconstructed clean phase 0/8); the phase selects above-left versus below-right routing.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Reconstruct the clean 5x5-periodic 0/8 lattice from modulo-class majorities, then locate every anomaly and read the reconstructed clean phase at that anomaly.
sequential_dependency.step_b: For each anomaly, use its reconstructed phase to choose a clipped 4x4 above-left window for phase 0 or below-right window for phase 8, then paint only reconstructed-zero cells with the anomaly fill color.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The route and therefore the painted mask are not determined by the observed anomaly value or position alone: B must consume A’s reconstructed clean phase. Crossed controls keep dimensions, positions and colors fixed while changing that phase and change the final label.
